body.value: Creation consumes the two actual owned Parts tickets, never a borrowed duplicate: immutable sequence and ordered lengths table. Cursor has no Arena or Bytes. Each transition moves the sole actual Arena and Usage. A real4096-byte control covers the fixed packed cursor; every lookup/allocation/release is prepaid by shared Core work. Nine actual Heap metadata nodes encode count,total,actual table representation,sequence link,length-table link and four fixed branches; the single final record owns both source graphs through charged edges. This is a Product descriptor schema, not a file-format identity or a generic trie assumption. Length validation is incremental with no count/whole-input ceiling, accepts actual wire slots or lengths metadata table kinds, and verifies exact sum against actual sequence length. Every achieved mutation Delta remains pending until takeDelta moves the actual retained event once to an enclosing source receipt owner; no rollback/second Arena snapshot. take transfers only the final record ticket once; Snapshot children are borrowed under it. Cancellation drains actual controls and roots; Heap release cursors own transferred release tickets. Raw view is a bounded developer primitive; production callers use paid readView or prepay viewWork before view. No digest, source/native physical allocation or ABI qualification follows.
